video_title: Tracy McGrady Reveals What Happened at Jay-Z's Concert + Vince Carter's Celebrity Golf Tournament

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on the star-studded 30th anniversary of Reasonable Doubt
quotes.excerpt: I'm in the suite here, then you got Jay-Z and his people, then you got Melo.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: I thought it was a moment that we will talk about 20, 30 years from now if we are lucky enough to be on this earth. It was just one of those moments. To have the 30th anniversary for Reasonable Doubt and to see the celebrities that came out and supported that. I am in the suite here, then you got Jay-Z and his people, then you got Melo in the suite over here, then you got Fat Joe. It was just a row of celebrities and me, I am just going to different suites and hollering at everybody.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on Jay-Z's performance and Blue Ivy's stage presence
quotes.excerpt: Nobody can touch him. I'm talking about the big picture of who Jay is.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: Nobody can touch him. I am talking about the big picture of who Jay is and what he does. The man brought his wife on the stage opening up with him, and then when he brought Blue Ivy playing the piano while he is singing, delivering, feeling it. Nobody can do that like Jay. And to have all the celebrities for three straight days sell out the Yankee Stadium is one of those moments. I am glad I got to witness it on that Friday, star-studded event.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Would you consider that one of the best moments of the show?

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady on Blue Ivy's piano performance at the concert
quotes.excerpt: You got Beyonce and then you got Blue Ivy blessing the stage, playing the piano.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: You got Beyonce and then you got Blue Ivy blessing the stage, playing the piano. That was it. That trumped everything because to learn how to play the piano, you are putting some hours in. Right? And I have never seen her perform in front of 50,000 people before. So to come out on that stage at this magnitude and perform like that, it is. She was dancing for her mom.

text_blocks.speaker: Vince Carter
text_blocks.text: Dancing is one thing, performing, playing the piano is a totally different thing.

text_blocks.speaker: Tracy McGrady
text_blocks.text: She had her own segment. It is a totally different thing. This is the setup for her for what we will be seeing from Blue Ivy in the future. She is going to be performing and you can tell she has it already. She is not afraid of the moment, she delivered.

quotes.speaker: Tracy McGrady
quotes.summary_phrase: Tracy McGrady lists his favorite Jay-Z songs
quotes.excerpt: I could go Blueprint, I could go Blueprint 2, I could go Moment of Clarity.
quotes.quote: I could go Blueprint, I could go Blueprint 2, I could go Moment of Clarity. Man, I could go Heart of the City, Song Cry. So you have a couple right there, you be ready to go.

quotes.speaker: Vince Carter
quotes.summary_phrase: Vince Carter on his experience at the American Century Championship
quotes.excerpt: I played in the American Century Championship and this is year nine or ten.
quotes.quote: I played in the American Century Championship and this is year nine or ten. You can play all the golf you want, casual golf is casual golf, competing and doing tournament golf is a different level. I am finally feeling comfortable where I obviously know the course. It is just putting it all together to compete. Shout out to Marty Fish who won it again and he is a guy who is shooting in the 60s, he is shooting with the pros. He gets after it. It was great to see that for many years there wasn't that many basketball players representing at the American Century Championship. Obviously you would see Ray, you would see Steph, you would see Dell, then all of a sudden we started seeing Seth. But now we have Alex Caruso, we have Austin Reaves, Kyle has been there, I was there, Barkley is there, and that is really it. We have had Iguodala play with him. It is not many of us, so it is just great to see Ray always up in contention, Steph finished third. My goal was to come in there feeling in the top half so it was 90 players and I wanted to finish in the top third, and I finished 36th this year.
